# OpenVariance

> Open source FP&A variance analysis. Compares actuals with a budget, forecast or prior period,
> explains why the numbers moved with a reconciling driver bridge, builds linked three-statement
> forecasts, reads messy accounting exports and SEC filings, and writes formula-driven Excel and
> HTML dashboards. Runs locally as a CLI and an MCP server. No API keys.

## Set up

- MCP (Claude Code): `claude mcp add openvariance -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/wavebyrd/openvariance openvariance mcp`
- MCP (other clients): command `uvx`, args `["--from", "git+https://github.com/wavebyrd/openvariance", "openvariance", "mcp"]`
- CLI: `uvx --from git+https://github.com/wavebyrd/openvariance openvariance demo`. Every command accepts `--json`.
- SEC data: set `OPENVARIANCE_SEC_USER_AGENT="Name email@example.com"`, using the user's own details.

## First steps

1. Call `load_demo`, then `run_variance(actual="actual", baseline="budget", period="2026-09")`.
2. For a user's files: `inspect_file` → confirm non-high-confidence mappings with the user → `import_file` → `run_variance`.
3. For a public company: `load_sec_company("TICKER")` → `run_forecast`.

## Rules

- Report only numbers returned by tools. Never calculate them yourself.
- Positive variance = favorable. Percent variance = variance / |baseline|. "n/m" = zero baseline.
- Stop on unmapped accounts or failed checks, and resolve them with the user.
